text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed","doc_id":"POL-002","attribute":"destination_port_range","title":"azurerm_network_security_rule.seed opens SSH with destination_port_range \"22\" from the internet via source_address_prefix \"0.0.0.0/0\", which violates the rule against admin ports being reachable from public networks.","suggestion":"Restrict SSH access to a bastion host or private network address range instead of allowing it from 0.0.0.0/0."}]}
